product_overview: Dompet Kita is a personal finance web application that provides dashboard summaries, transaction management, loan tracking, reporting, receipt OCR, and goals/wealth tracking with secure backend connectivity. The product focuses on clear financial insights, easy transaction entry, and production-grade security and deployment.
core_goals: Provide a clear, up-to-date financial summary (income, expenses, balance) on the dashboard.
Allow users to create, edit, and manage financial transactions reliably with validation and sync to the backend.
Support tracking of loans (lent/borrowed) and loan lifecycle actions like marking paid.
Offer reporting and export capabilities to analyze finances over time.
Enable receipt scanning (OCR) to quickly convert receipts into transactions.
Support goal tracking (Mimpi Kita), holiday planning, and wealth/asset tracking.
Maintain strong security, observability, and reliable cross-origin connectivity between frontend and backend.

features.name: Dashboard Overview
features.description: Provides a concise summary of the user's current balance, income, and expenses and displays charts for quick insights.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> See loading indicator for summary -> See summary cards for income, expenses, and balance -> View charts
Navigate to / -> See loading indicator for summary -> See error message 'Unable to load summary' -> Click Retry -> See loading indicator -> See summary cards

features.name: Transaction Management
features.description: Add, edit, delete, and view transactions with form validation and list pagination.
user_flows: Navigate to /transactions -> Click 'Add Transaction' button -> Fill amount field -> Fill category field -> Fill description field -> Click Submit -> See new transaction in list

Navigate to /transactions -> Click 'Add Transaction' button -> Fill amount field with invalid value (e.g., non-numeric) -> Click Submit -> See validation error 'Invalid amount' -> Correct amount -> Click Submit -> See new transaction in list
Navigate to /transactions -> Click on a transaction item -> Click Edit -> Change a field -> Click Save -> See updated transaction in list
Navigate to /transactions -> Click Delete on a transaction -> Confirm deletion -> API returns error -> See error toast 'Could not delete transaction'

features.name: Loan Tracking
features.description: Track money lent to or borrowed from others, add new loans, and mark loans as paid.
user_flows: Navigate to /loans -> Click 'Add Loan' -> Fill borrower/lender, amount, and notes -> Click Save -> See loan appear in loan list
Navigate to /loans -> Click 'Mark as paid' on an active loan -> Confirm action -> See loan marked as paid in list
Navigate to /loans -> Click 'Mark as paid' on an active loan -> Confirm action -> API returns 500 error -> See error message 'Unable to update loan status' -> Retry action

features.name: Reports
features.description: Generate financial reports and charts for selected date ranges, apply filters, and export data.
user_flows: Navigate to /reports -> Select start date -> Select end date -> Click 'Generate' -> See report charts and tables populated
Navigate to /reports -> Select start date after end date -> Click 'Generate' -> See validation error 'Invalid date range' -> Adjust dates -> Click 'Generate' -> See report charts
Navigate to /reports -> Generate a report with data -> Click 'Export' -> Download CSV file

features.name: Receipt Scanner (OCR)
features.description: Scan or upload receipts to extract transaction data via OCR and create transactions from scanned results.
user_flows: Navigate to /scan -> Click 'Upload Receipt' -> Choose receipt image file -> See uploading indicator -> See OCR results populated into a form -> Review fields -> Click 'Save as Transaction' -> See new transaction in /transactions list

Navigate to /scan -> Click 'Upload Receipt' -> Choose a blurred image -> See uploading indicator -> See OCR error 'Unable to extract data' -> Click 'Retry OCR' -> If still failing see suggestion 'Enter transaction manually' and a button to open /transactions -> Click to open /transactions

features.name: Financial Goals (Mimpi Kita)
features.description: Create and track financial goals, monitor progress, and update contributions toward each goal.
user_flows: Navigate to /mimpi-kita -> Click 'Create Goal' -> Enter goal name, target amount, and target date -> Click Save -> See new goal listed with 0% progress
Navigate to /mimpi-kita -> Click on an existing goal -> Click 'Add Contribution' -> Enter contribution amount -> Click Save -> See goal progress updated
Navigate to /mimpi-kita -> Click 'Create Goal' -> Leave required fields empty -> Click Save -> See validation errors indicating missing fields

features.name: Holiday Planning
features.description: Plan holidays, allocate budgets, and track holiday-related expenses.
user_flows: Navigate to /holiday -> Click 'Create Holiday Plan' -> Enter trip name, budget, and dates -> Click Save -> See holiday plan created with budget summary
Navigate to /holiday -> Open a holiday plan -> Click 'Add Expense' -> Fill expense amount and description -> Click Save -> See expense added and budget updated
Navigate to /holiday -> Click 'Create Holiday Plan' -> Enter negative budget -> Click Save -> See validation error 'Budget must be positive'

features.name: Wealth & Asset Tracking
features.description: Track assets and net worth over time with entries for investments, properties, and other assets.
user_flows: Navigate to /wealth -> Click 'Add Asset' -> Enter asset name, current value, and category -> Click Save -> See asset in asset list and net worth updated

Navigate to /wealth -> Click 'Add Asset' -> Enter invalid value (e.g., text in value field) -> Click Save -> See validation error 'Enter a numeric value' -> Correct value -> Click Save -> See asset listed
